programs.title: Road absurdities 3
programs.desc: The crew of Syrena V8 in Nowosolna near Łódź will have to drive through the intersection of eight streets.In Łódź itself, the team will look at absurd prohibition signs on Nowogrodzka and traffic jam detours through closed streets near Strykowska.Another interesting place is Apteczna Street in Skarżysko-Kamienna, where the entry of vehicles weighing over 1.5 tons is prohibited.The absurd landscape of Polish roads also includes: a private dummy speed camera in Mniszew, a pointless bicycle path on Zawrat Street in Warsaw and a blocked road at the intersection of Miedziana and Prosta.

programs.title: Road absurdities 3
programs.desc: We will take a ride around the "absurd Bermuda Triangle" Warsaw-Łódź-Kalisz.Syrena V8 will also visit the shortest undeveloped area between Eufeminów and Jordanów.Krzysiek and Kamil will look at the senseless signs and barriers in Łódź and show the bicycle path that is the only access to one of the properties in Kalisz.Absurdity hunters will also pay attention to the narrow viaduct without a sidewalk.In Warsaw, however, they will come across parking spaces fenced off with bollards and traffic lights shining into the bushes.
